priorityList: Cast Mirror Image and start a Pyroblast hard-cast pre-combat.
Activate Combustion while finishing a Fireball, Scorch, or Pyroblast cast to ensure the buff is active for the hit.
During Combustion, cast Meteor if it is available and the buff has more than 2 seconds remaining.
During Combustion, spend Hot Streak procs immediately on Pyroblast.
During Combustion, use Fire Blast to convert Heating Up into a Hot Streak if no Hot Streak is currently active.
During Combustion, hard-cast Pyroblast if Pyroclasm is active and you do not have a Hot Streak proc.
Outside of Combustion, spend Hot Streak procs immediately on Pyroblast.
Outside of Combustion, hard-cast Pyroblast if Pyroclasm is at 2 stacks or if Combustion cooldown is longer than 12 seconds.
Use Meteor if talented into Blast Zone, or if Sunfury Execution is talented and Combustion has less than 12 seconds remaining on cooldown.
Use Scorch when Heat Shimmer procs, or as a filler when the target is below 30% health (if Scald is talented).
Use Fire Blast to convert Heating Up into a Hot Streak, ideally while another spell is already being cast.
Use Fireball as your primary filler to generate Heating Up.
Use offensive trinkets, racials (like Berserking or Blood Fury), and Power Infusion when Combustion has more than 6 seconds remaining.
Use a Potion of Power during Combustion or if the fight is ending in less than 35 seconds.
During Combustion, prioritize Scorch over Fireball if the target is below 30% health.
